notes.title: Cardinal Descent Beta!
notes.content:
If you haven't already, sign up to the beta here

The Cardinal Descent beta is launching 23/05/2025! Sign up now to get exclusive access to this element based roguelike deckbuilder before anyone else.

What You Get:

 Free access to the beta through Steam for a limited time.
 A chance to shape the game by providing feedback.
 Exclusive insights and updates before the full release - expect 1 email per month after the beta


Beta Overview:

 Access is temporary—beta keys will be revoked after the 25th of May
 Feedback will be greatly appreciated
 Spots are limited, so sign up now to secure your beta key!
